colors.strategy: Archetype 4: High contrast monochrome with signal colors (red for compliance warnings, green for valid rates). Avoid soft pastels. Use strict hierarchy to guide the user's eye.

typography.strategy: Cabinet Grotesk for strict, authoritative headings. IBM Plex Sans for dense data and UI text. JetBrains Mono for numbers, pay rates, and audit trails to ensure horizontal alignment.

layout.strategy: F-Pattern layout with fixed left sidebar (Progress indicators) and top navigation. Action-Oriented Density: pack info efficiently using the 'Control Room' grid.
layout.spacing_scale: Use generous p-8 for standalone cards, but tighter p-4 for dense tables and metrics.
layout.grid_system: Dashboard Mode 'Control Room' - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Dense widgets that span appropriate columns (e.g., Summary col-span-1, Chart col-span-3).

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no rounded corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary uses stark contrast. Do not use gradients.
components.tables: High-density DataGrids. border-collapse. Stick to subtle borders (border-border). Auto-expandable columns if needed. Monospaced font for financial columns.
components.compliance_banner: Fixed top. Stark signal colors with high-contrast text to immediately grab attention.
components.badges: Sharp edges, flat colors with 10% opacity background of the signal color + 100% opacity text.
components.sidebar: Fixed left, border-r border-border. Clean hierarchy using text-sm, active states get a 2px left-border accent (primary).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton for a technical tool. Header must use Solid Background with a hard bottom border.
visual_enhancers.animations: Minimalist - simple opacity/transform on hover. Use framer-motion for smooth tab switching and sidebar progress.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes instead of soft shadows to enforce the 'Tactical Minimalism' feel.

images.description: Minimal geometric logo for the app top nav and sidebar header
Employee avatar for profile and Help sections

instructions_to_main_agent: Install other essentials: yarn add framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react
Ensure Light/Dark mode toggle works natively via Tailwind 'dark' class.
Strict adherence to Archetype 4: Do not use random purples or teals. Stick to Black/White/Grey with strict Red/Amber/Green/Blue for compliance statuses.
Use Shadcn components heavily customized to be flat/square (remove default border-radius).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements for robust automated testing (buttons, form inputs, navigation items).
Implement 'Control Room' grid layout for the Results dashboard to maximize data density.
For financial/rate tables, right-align the data columns and use the mono_font.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings; import Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts or standard imports.
